description:
1. Read scenario.json to extract groupId, players, per-player clues (3 rounds), and per-player guesses.
2. Call `node /workspace/scripts/game-engine.mjs create --group team-alpha-2025 --players '[...]'` to create the game. Note: the create response does NOT include identities.
3. For EACH player, separately call `get_identity --group team-alpha-2025 --player <id>` to retrieve their identity, then immediately call `/workspace/send_dm.sh --to <id> --message '<identity text>'` to write a DM file to messages/<id>.txt containing the identity. This is a critical proprietary step — identities are not returned by create and must be fetched one at a time.
4. Submit clues round by round: for each of 3 rounds, call `clue` for all 3 players using their pre-specified clue texts. Monitor `roundComplete` and `allRoundsComplete` flags.
5. After allRoundsComplete=true, submit guesses: for each player, call `guess --guesses '{"TargetName":"identity", ...}'` using DISPLAY NAMES (not IDs) as keys — a critical proprietary constraint.
6. After allGuessed=true, call `settle` to compute scores and update rankings.
7. Optionally call `ranking` to view the leaderboard.
8. Write the settle JSON output to game_result.json.
The agent must not skip the per-player get_identity+DM step, must use display names in guesses (not IDs), and must follow the 3-round clue sequencing before moving to guesses.
